messages:
erin_support: FYI — customer (acct: acct_789) opened a ticket: console shows $50 free credit banner but API billing/usage is zero. They can call endpoints; tokens work, but usage meter and invoice ledger show no deductions. Asking for urgent help, they want the credits applied before EOD.

mike_billing: Thanks Erin. Do we have the account creation timestamp and the promo code applied? sometimes promos are attached but not synced to metering.

erin_support: Promo = FREE-TRIAL-2024, granted at 2024-02-18T16:12Z. Customer screenshot attached in ticket (banner + promo code in console). They included an example request id: req_01G8YVJZP0.

sophie_apieng: Quick checklist: (1) Does the metering job pick up promo grants? (2) Any failures in the billing worker? Can someone grep logs for promo grant sync for acct_789 around grant time.

ali_infra: I pulled the metering-worker logs. There was an error when processing a webhook from promo-service at 2024-02-18T16:12:05Z: "KVLookupError: promo_index not found". It looks like the grant was created in promo-service but the async notification to metering failed and never retried.

mike_billing: That matches — console reads from promo-service directly, so UI shows the banner. Metering depends on a grant_write event to billing queue. If the webhook failed, ledger wouldn't get the credit balance.

erin_support: Customer expects credits to be usable immediately. What's the remediation path? Can we backfill and force-sync?

sophie_apieng: Yes. We have an admin backfill: `POST /admin/backfill/credits` with payload `{ "account_id": "acct_789", "reason": "promo_grant_missed_webhook" }` — that enqueues a retrospective grant and writes to ledger. Need someone with admin token to run it. Also will add a retry for the webhook.

ali_infra: I can run the backfill. Running now and watching the billing queue...

billing-bot: enqueued job job_87234 for backfill (acct_789). status: queued. ETA: short.

ali_infra: job_87234 started. Processing events... found the original promo object in promo-store, applying grant to ledger with trace_id trace_20240218161205.

billing-bot: job_87234 completed. result: 1 grant_applied, ledger_entries_created: 1, new_free_balance: 50.00 USD.

mike_billing: Confirmed: ledger shows +50.00 free credits on acct_789 and metering reports now returning non-zero remaining_credits via the API: `GET /v1/accounts/acct_789/credits` -> `{ "remaining": 50.0 }`.

erin_support: I let the customer know and asked them to retry. They reported they can see credits in API now and calls are consuming them. :tada:

sophie_apieng: Postmortem actions: (1) add retry on promo-service -> billing webhook with exponential backoff; (2) add a metric alert when promo grants are in console but ledger has no corresponding grant after 1hr; (3) run a one-off reconciliation for grants from last 30 days.

ali_infra: Filed infra ticket INFRA-1429 for webhook retries and retried queue config.

mike_billing: Filed billing ticket BILL-893 for the reconciliation task.

erin_support: Customer satisfied, closing ticket after confirmation. Thanks team.

ali_infra: Small follow-up: I also patched the metering-worker to log raw webhook payloads when a lookup fails. Will monitor for similar failures.

sophie_apieng: Nice. Marking this resolved here. :thumbsup:

mike_billing: Closing loop with ops and support, adding note to the account: "Backfilled promo grant FREE-TRIAL-2024 on 2024-02-20 via admin backfill job_87234; root cause webhook failure (promo_index missing)."

erin_support: Closing thread — thanks all.
